title: Independent verification: exact bounded modular replay of #741 backward endpoint
body:
**Independent finite verification; no new kappa.** This independently checks the selected #741 backward scalar endpoint on all **728 native plus eight arbitrary private-center columns** using modular sparse matrices and an explicit deterministic reconstruction bound.

The endpoint denominator exponent is at most 19. Every scaled integer residual has magnitude at most `1582669748628115714804285440`. Two pairwise coprime odd moduli, `4294967297` and `18446744073709551617`, have product greater than twice that bound. Both modular matrices equal the desired shear, proving the exact finite identity without rational-matrix replay or a primality assumption.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/sw4-crt-endpoint/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_SW4_EXACT_MODULAR_ENDPOINT columns=736 moduli=2 controls=7`.

Seven adversarial controls include a deliberately incorrect circuit that passes **both raw modular replays** but fails the recomputed height guard, demonstrating why modular screening alone is insufficient. Other controls cover insufficient/duplicate moduli, endpoint error, a first-modulus-blind error, dirty-center initialization and nondyadic coefficients. Windows Python 3.14 normal/optimized, Linux Python 3.12, Ruff and staged whitespace checks pass.

Only `research/sw4-crt-endpoint/` is added. Base `7ee02b7c96d85f22b38d28bd7ed49bb8c1aeb261`; source #741 `e516b1463606840a15f80aac1995d64ce0092e89`; immutable input payload pins and exact receipt included. No existing constructor or verifier is imported. Seed 80, alternatives and the local claim are recorded; no pinned sprint issue exists. Final overlap scan through #834 found no matching endpoint reconstruction.

Scope is the backward finite scalar projection: frames, physical hosting, child execution, coefficient-work lowering, precision/tape and all-size/analytic obligations remain inherited. This is not a formal multiplication theorem, a new bound, a forward replay or a full cold rebuild. Current selected kappa remains `1661202643272239/1000000000000000000`.

Credit Chafik Boukhalfa, Jeremy Kothe and the retained #741 construction/audit lineage; related #668 CRT work concerns cyclic resultants and #777 concerns frame geometry. Prepared by Ryan Haines (@Ryan-Haines) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.
